bugs.text: Undo after 'Save a copy' goes back into the original song and overwrites it (the original can end up empty).
bugs.steps: New song → 'drums like Charlotte de Witte' → 'add a bassline' → Save → Save a copy (title 'Original (copy)') → Undo. Title switches back to 'Original' and every later change/Undo autosaves into the original; in a longer run the saved original went from 174 BPM, 1 track to 78 BPM, 0 tracks. Expected: the copy starts its own history; the original is never touched. Suspect: saveCopy() in src/daw.js doesn't call undoReset(); undo snapshots carry the original PROJ.id.

bugs.text: Tempo typed in the BPM box (or Tap) is not an undo step: Undo also undoes the edit before it, and Redo loses the new tempo.
bugs.steps: 'hip hop beat at 88 bpm like J Dilla' → 'add chords' → type 96 in BPM, Enter → Undo: chords removed AND tempo back to 88 → Redo: chords back, tempo stays 88. Expected: tempo change is its own undo step. Cause: #bpm change / Tap call setTempo() (src/studio.js) which never calls saveProject().

bugs.text: Basic mode: 'afro house beat' makes plain House (909 kit, clap, 124 BPM) instead of Afro.
bugs.steps: New song → type 'afro house beat' (or 'make an afro house groove with congas'). Reply 'House style, House drums on 909 House Kit…'. Expected afro style (rim, shaker, percussion, ~120 BPM). Cause: STYLE_WORDS in src/maker.js lists house before afro. Same on preview-ai-1/4/6/7.

bugs.text: Basic mode: 'unsolo the bass' rewrites the bassline and keeps the solo; 'un-mute the drums' mutes them; 'remove the solo' not understood.
bugs.steps: Song with drums/bass/chords/melody, press S on the bass, type 'unsolo the bass' → new bassline, still soloed. Mute drums, type 'un-mute the drums' → 'Drums: muted'. Expected: clear solo / unmute, notes untouched. Cause: mixVerb regex in src/maker.js. Still on preview-ai-6.

bugs.text: Basic mode: 'quantize my melody to 1/8' adds a new Melody track; 'quantize it' / 'tighten up the timing' not understood.
bugs.steps: Any song with a melody → type 'quantize my melody to 1/8' → 'Melody 2 (new track)'. Expected: run the existing quantize action (in actions.js and the Worker prompt; missing from maker.js). Not on any preview branch.

bugs.text: Basic mode: two requests in one sentence do the wrong thing or silently drop the second half.
bugs.steps: 'more reverb on the chords and less on the melody' → chords reverb goes DOWN 24%→22%. 'make the drums louder and the bass quieter' → only drums; 'mute the drums and solo the bass' → only mute; 'set the tempo to 128 and add a shaker' → tempo ignored. Replies don't mention the skipped part. Same on preview-ai-6.

bugs.text: Keys names an artist the user didn't say.
bugs.steps: 'drums like Black Coffee' → 'Keinemusik-style drums…'; 'lofi hip hop beat' → 'Lofi Girl-style drums…', and PROJ.ref is set to that name. Expected: echo the name the user said (or 'lo-fi drums'). Cause: reply uses ARTISTS row's first name; 'lofi' is an alias of the Lofi Girl row.

bugs.text: Big EQ boosts push the master over 0 dBFS and the Ableton zip Mix.wav hard-clips (MP3 is normalised and fine).
bugs.steps: CdW drums+bass+chords+melody, all faders 100, Low/High +15 on drums and bass, Master Low +15, max reverb/delay/drive/comp → render peak +0.23 dBFS, 54 clipped samples per loop, true peak +0.1 dBTP; live analyser 1 over. Realistic settings (faders 100, +6 lows) stay at -0.32 dBFS. Expected: master never exceeds 0 dBFS (clip guard after the limiter, or normalise the zip mix like the MP3).

ideas.text: Master meter on the Master strip: peak / true peak, short-term LUFS and a red clip light. Why: a mix can go +0.2 dBFS today with nothing on screen; producers watch level and loudness constantly.
Audition songs from the Open song… list (▶ plays 4 bars of each saved song without opening it). Why: with several sketches you pick by ear, and opening each one resets undo.

Basic mode answers simple questions ('what key / tempo is this?') from the project and offers 'did you mean …?' chips for near-miss typos ('add a basline', 'anothr one') instead of the trap-beat fallback. Why: 7 of 34 natural phrasings got 'I couldn't turn that into a change'.
